table.name: hall_of_fame
table.purpose: Baseball Hall of Fame balloting results: one row per candidate per voting body per year, recording vote counts, ballot thresholds, and whether the candidate was inducted (1936–2016).

ballots.name: ballots
ballots.description: Total number of ballots cast in that year's vote by that voting body; the denominator for vote share.

category.name: category
category.description: The role in which the person was considered: Player, Manager, Umpire, or Pioneer/Executive.

inducted.name: inducted
inducted.description: Whether the candidate was inducted into the Hall of Fame as a result of that vote (Y/N).

needed.name: needed
needed.description: Number of votes required for induction in that election (typically 75% of ballots cast).

needed_note.name: needed_note
needed_note.description: Annotation about the vote threshold context, e.g. '1st' (first-year/primary ballot) or 'Top 20' (runoff/nominating vote); empty for normal BBWAA ballots.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Identifier of the person under consideration; references player.player_id (covers players, managers, umpires, executives).

votedby.name: voted_by
votedby.description: Voting body or election type: BBWAA (Baseball Writers' Association of America), Veterans Committee, Run Off, Nominating Vote, Old Timers, Special Election, Negro League, Final Ballot, etc.

votes.name: votes
votes.description: Number of votes the candidate received in that election.

yearid.name: year
yearid.description: Year of the Hall of Fame election (1936–2016).

table.name: player
table.purpose: Biographical master table of baseball players (Lahman-style database): one row per player with birth/death data, names, and physical attribute; referenced by hall_of_fame, player_award, player_award_vote, and salary.

birth_city.name: birth_city
birth_city.description: City where the player was born.

birth_country.name: birth_country
birth_country.description: Country of birth; mostly standardized codes (USA, CAN, D.R., P.R.) with some full names (Cuba, Venezuela, Switzerland).

birth_day.name: birth_day
birth_day.description: Day-of-month component of the birth date (1-31).

birth_month.name: birth_month
birth_month.description: Month component of the birth date (1-12); empty string when unknown.

birth_state.name: birth_state
birth_state.description: State/province of birth, mostly US state codes (CA, PA, NY); some non-US values present (e.g. Holguin, Worcestershire), so data quality is mixed.

death_city.name: death_city
death_city.description: City where the player died; empty string for living players.

death_country.name: death_country
death_country.description: Country of death; empty string for living players.

death_day.name: death_day
death_day.description: Day-of-month component of death date; empty string for living players.

death_month.name: death_month
death_month.description: Month component of death date; empty string for living players.

death_state.name: death_state
death_state.description: State/province of death (US state codes); empty string for living players.

death_year.name: death_year
death_year.description: Year of death (1872-2016); empty string for living players.

name_first.name: name_first
name_first.description: Player's commonly used first name or nickname (e.g. 'Sugar', 'Happy').

name_given.name: name_given
name_given.description: Player's full given (legal) name, may include middle names.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Primary key; unique player identifier in lastname+firstname+sequence format (e.g. aaronha01). Referenced by hall_of_fame, player_award, player_award_vote, and salary.

table.name: player_award
table.purpose: Awards won by baseball players (e.g., MVP, Gold Glove, All-Star selections), one row per player, award, league, and year. Likely the Lahman baseball database's AwardsPlayers table. Primary key is presumably (player_id, award_id, year, league_id).

award_id.name: award_name
award_id.description: Name of the award won (e.g., Most Valuable Player, Gold Glove, Silver Slugger, TSN All-Star, Baseball Magazine All-Star, NLCS MVP, Pitching Triple Crown).

league_id.name: league
league_id.description: League in which the award was won: AL = American League, NL = National League, ML = Major League Baseball (both leagues / overall), AA = American Association (19th century).

notes.name: notes
notes.description: Supplementary detail about the award, most often the position played (OF, SS, 3B, 1B, RF, DH), sometimes handedness (LHP) or game number (e.g., '1st Game', 'P4' for All-Star Game pitcher).

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Identifier of the player who won the award; references player.player_id (e.g., bondsba01 = Barry Bonds).

tie.name: tie
tie.description: Whether the award was shared/tied with another player: 'Y' if tied, empty otherwise.

year.name: award_year
year.description: Season/year in which the award was won, 1877-2015.

table.name: player_award_vote
table.purpose: Baseball award voting results: each row is one player's vote total for a given award (MVP, Cy Young, Rookie of the Year) in a league and season, showing points won, maximum possible points, and first-place votes. Likely the Lahman baseball database's AwardsVote table (1911-2015).

award_id.name: award
award_id.description: Name of the award being voted on: MVP (most valuable player), Cy Young (best pitcher), Rookie of the Year.

league_id.name: league
league_id.description: League in which the award was voted: AL (American League), NL (National League), ML (major leagues, pre-split/combined voting, e.g. early MVP).

player_id.name: player
player_id.description: Identifier of the player who received votes; references player.player_id (many votes to one player).

points_max.name: maximum_possible_points
points_max.description: Total points available in that year's voting (e.g. 336 = 14 voters x 24 points for MVP); the winner's points_won equals this value.

points_won.name: points_received
points_won.description: Voting points the player received in that award vote; 0 to points_max.

votes_first.name: first_place_votes
votes_first.description: Number of first-place votes the player received; empty string means unknown/not recorded (358 rows), otherwise 0-32.

table.name: salary
table.purpose: Annual player salaries in Major League Baseball: one row per player per team per league per season (1985-2015), recording the salary paid in US dollars.

league_id.name: league_id
league_id.description: Baseball league the player's team belonged to that season: 'NL' = National League, 'AL' = American League.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Identifier of the player, referencing player.player_id (many-to-one). Encoded as lastname + first initials + sequence number (e.g. moyerja01 = Jamie Moyer).

salary.name: salary
salary.description: The player's salary for that season, in US dollars (whole dollars; range 0 to 33,000,000, median 550,000).

team_id.name: team_id
team_id.description: Franchise/team code the player was paid by that season (e.g. CLE Cleveland, LAN Los Angeles Dodgers, NYA New York Yankees, MON Montreal Expos). No join target exists in this database, so the exact team lookup is unavailable.

year.name: year
year.description: Season year the salary applies to, 1985-2015.
